The '''Arrow-7''' was a type of [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] manufactured by [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Arend Shen]] owned at least one of this airspeeder.
